overview.title: Overview
overview.isolationCleanupWarningSub: A previously-distributed operator token may still be on this server. Reinstalling the harness will clean it up.
overview.isolationCleanupToastFailed: Isolated execution enabled, but cleaning up the existing operator token failed. See the notice on this server's Overview page.
overview.isolationCleanupToastSkipped: Isolated execution enabled, but the operator token cleanup was skipped (no reachable host). See the notice on this server's Overview page.
overview.isolationBlockedByWindowsToast: Cannot enable isolation: {{count}} window(s) are registered on this server and may hold injected credentials. Close them, then try again.
overview.isolationBlockedByLiveSessionsToast: Cannot enable isolation: {{count}} live tmux session(s) exist on this server. End them, then try again.
overview.isolationBlockedBySessionCheckFailureToa: Cannot enable isolation: listing tmux sessions failed, so the change was aborted to fail safe. Check the server connection, then try again.
overview.isolationBlocksConnectionChangeToast: Cannot change connection info while isolation is enabled. Disabling isolation and changing the connection cannot be combined in one save. First save only the isolation-disable change, confirm it took effect, then change the connection in a separate save.
overview.isolationBlocksAgentInstallToast: Cannot reinstall the agent while isolation is enabled. Disable isolation first, then reinstall.
overview.isolationRequiresScopedAuthToast: Cannot enable isolation: scoped auth (AZITO_SCOPED_AUTH) is off. Run `azito auth doctor` until green, set AZITO_SCOPED_AUTH=1, then run `azito token rotate` before trying again.
overview.isolationDoctorScopedAuthDisabledSub: Scoped auth (AZITO_SCOPED_AUTH) is disabled, so verification results (including past ones) are meaningless. In compat mode, a task principal is operator-equivalent for every API route, so isolation is not actually enforced. Re-verify after enabling scoped auth.
overview.isolationDoctorScopedAuthUnknownSub: Could not confirm whether scoped auth is enabled (the health check hasn't loaded, or failed). A previously passing verification cannot be shown as current until this is confirmed. Try reconnecting.
overview.isolationDoctorNeedsAttentionSub: The following checks failed or could not be confirmed: {{checks}}
overview.isolationDoctorSnapshotNotice: This result is a snapshot taken at verification time and detects misconfiguration — it is not a guarantee or attestation. It cannot detect an adversarial host itself; that is handled structurally by withholding credentials (layer 2, the credential-distribution gate).
overview.isolationReportUnavailableTitle: Isolation status could not be confirmed
overview.isolationReportUnavailableSub: This server declares isolated execution, but its status could not be fetched or was in an unexpected format. It may still hold a previously-distributed operator token. Retry, or check the server connection.
overview.isolationCleanupReportUnavailableTitle: Cleanup outcome could not be confirmed
overview.isolationCleanupReportUnavailableSub: This server declares isolated execution, but the operator-token cleanup outcome could not be fetched or was in an unexpected format. It may still hold a previously-distributed operator token. Retry, or check the server connection.
overview.isolationPurposeSub: Isolating a server lets it automatically run untrusted tasks from external sources (e.g. GitHub issues), without approval on every run.
overview.misaoUnreachable: Cannot connect to misao. You can check it from a terminal with misao status.
overview.misaoUnreachableSub: Check that the daemon is running and that MISAO_SOCKET is correct.
overview.misaoIncompatible: The misao daemon's protocol does not match this hub
overview.misaoIncompatibleSub: Reinstall the daemon at a version this hub supports. The hub keeps retrying at an interval, so it recovers without a restart once that is fixed.
overview.misaoDriverNotRegistered: The misao driver is not registered in the hub
overview.misaoNotInstalled: misao is not installed on this server
overview.misaoNotInstalledSub: Install it from Setup (Install misao). The hub sends its own copy through the agent.

setup.title: Setup
setup.checkFailedNotice: Failed to load the setup status.
setup.offlineNotice: The server is unreachable, so the setup status cannot be checked.
setup.managedTmuxDesc: Deploys a static tmux 3.5 build to ~/.azito/tmux/ (no root required, SHA256 verified, x86_64/arm64).
setup.managedAlready: This server is already configured as managed.
setup.managedSwitch: The server's mux runtime will be switched to managed.
setup.selfInstallDesc: Install tmux using your OS package manager.
setup.urlDialogDesc: Select the URL for the remote server to connect to the hub.
setup.rollingBack: Rolling back mux runtime to system…
setup.tmuxOptionalNote: Optional. Only needed for tmux windows (AZITO panes run on the bundled misao).
setup.misaoInstallFailedOnAdd: The agent was installed, but misao could not be installed: {{error}}. Install it from the server's Setup.

windows.noSessions: No sessions found on this server.

danger.resetFingerprintDesc: Removes the stored SSH host key. The server's key will be re-acquired on the next connection.
danger.resetFingerprintConfirm: Reset the fingerprint? A new key will be acquired on the next connection.
danger.deleteServerDesc: Permanently removes this server from AZITO. Data on the remote server is not affected.

misaoService.loadFailed: Could not read the misao service state.
misaoService.updateConfirmMessage: misao is stopped to update it. Every running pane ends and agent work in them is interrupted. Finish what you need before continuing.
misaoService.replaceSocketTitle: Switch the hub to the managed misao?
misaoService.replaceSocketMessage: The hub setting (MISAO_SOCKET) points at another daemon than the misao AZITO manages. Installing rewrites it to the managed socket (applied when the hub restarts).

notice.incompatible: The misao protocol does not match this hub
notice.incompatibleSub: Updating to the bundled misao fixes this. The update ends every running pane.
notice.updateAvailable: The running misao ({{running}}) differs from the bundled release ({{bundled}})
notice.updateAvailableSub: A hub update does not replace misao. Update it with the button above when you do not need the panes.
notice.needsHubRestart: Restart the hub to connect to the misao AZITO manages
notice.needsHubRestartSub: Restarting the hub does not end misao panes.
notice.customSocket: The hub setting (MISAO_SOCKET) points at another daemon
notice.customSocketSub: Installing rewrites that setting to the managed socket.

unmanaged.sourceInstall: A source checkout does not install the service. It connects to the misao at MISAO_SOCKET or the default socket.
unmanaged.noBundledMisao: This hub release does not bundle misao.
unmanaged.unsupportedPlatform: This host has neither systemd nor launchd, so the misao service cannot be managed.
unmanaged.invalidPrefix: The install path is too long to create the misao socket.
unmanaged.unknown: This hub cannot manage the misao service.

agentMisao.installDesc: Sends the misao bundled with this hub to the server through its agent and starts it as a service. Nothing is downloaded on the server.
agentMisao.notInstallable: This hub does not bundle misao, so it cannot install it on a server.
agentMisao.updateAvailable: The running misao ({{running}}) differs from the bundled release ({{bundled}})
agentMisao.updateAvailableSub: It is not switched automatically: switching ends every pane on this server. Update it when no work is running there.
